NCS includes various devices such as monitoring tool, search radar based-on Smart DDS. Because of this construct, it is unable to handle rapidly problems communicating when they occur in wartime situation. To handle quickly the problems, this study can detect the problems in real-time using interface of Smart DDS layers. Previous detection schemes are unsuitable on urgent wartime situation because they has several unnecessary requests. In this paper, proposed scheme detects rapidly problems using the Smart DDS layers interface. Simulation results show that proposed scheme reduces the latency for detecting problems compared with existing debugging tools, and it is expected to improve the recovery performance of NCS.

articleTitle: Single element differentiation of chemical vapors using an array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: We present a heterosensor array that exploits the collective recognition ability of a set of different gas sensors to identify individual chemical vapors. In contrast to the conventional sensing approach based on the "lock-and-key" design, the heterosensor array rely on the response patterns produced over the collection of different sensors. Diverse sensors with different operating principles are employed to provide as much chemical diversity as possible. We demonstrate that this platform provides a highly discriminative tool with single element precision.

articleTitle: SelfID: How to make personal ID photo using selfie
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: Selfies have perspective distortion problem because of a short distance between face and camera. The closer the distance is, the worse the perspective distortion problem. To resolve this problem, the portrait should be taken from long distance. In this paper, the proposed method, referred to as SelfID, solves this problem by manipulating perspective distortion without taking the portrait from long distance. Ultimately, ID photo that looks like taken from long distance is created from the selfie taken from short distance using simple 3-dimensional model fitting.

articleTitle: Development of a cognitive rehabilitation content using smart blocks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: We developed a new cognitive rehabilitation content, called "Family tree ", based on the internet of things (IoT). The content consisted of three interactive parts, a smart phone application, a smart block and a family tree game board. We designed the content to cover an exercise therapy method, an emotional stimulation method and a memory training method for the cognitive rehabilitation of patients. Since our content includes various treatment strategies, it could be applied to develop effective cognitive rehabilitation contents for improving long-term memory, working memory, concentration and fine motor skill.

articleTitle: A method for fingerprint enrollment by finger rubbing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: In these days, most fingerprint enrollment schemes for small mobile sensors ask the user cooperation to acquire wide finger coverage by requesting many input images. Nevertheless, it may still not be enough as some input images may cover the same part of the fingerprint. Therefore, we propose a novel enrollment scheme capturing all input images at one time by rubbing the finger on a sensor without touching-off during the whole enrollment process. Then, optimal image selection is followed for selecting best images among all input images to maximize the fingerprint coverage with less number of enrollment images. Experimental results showed that Equal Error Rate (EER) is about 30% improved compared to the conventional enrollment scheme.

articleTitle: Maritime safety system using Bluetooth low energy and global positioning system
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: Communications are a key part of inshore fisheries and sailing vessels. Especially, it can be regarded as an essential element for the ship's safety. However, unlike terrestrial communication, there is a disadvantage in that fixed terrain cannot be used. Therefore, communications of maritime were common to use a satellite or combinations of VHF and satellite. However, in case of fishing vessels using marine resources, although they cannot prepare for marine accidents, they don't use those communications on the coast because of exposing their fishing positions such as their know-how. In this paper, we propose a system that can additionally contribute to preventing marine accidents as making a local network by using Bluetooth and notifying the dangerous situation at the coast.

articleTitle: Impact of dynamic control format indicator on downlink throughput performance in LTE system
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: This paper presents an integrated study of dynamic control format indicator impact on downlink throughput in Long Term Evolution (LTE) network based on number of users and configured system bandwidth. CFI (Control Format Indicator) is an indicator notifying number of OFDM symbols used for carrying PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) at each subframe. CFI can be configured in Static and dynamic modes. Static CFI uses fixed number of OFDM symbols for the control channels in a subframe, while in Dynamic CFI symbol value is computed at every sub frame based on the total number of DCI (Downlink Control Information) grants. An End-to-End LTE testing environment is built by using real User Equipment (UE) and LTE core network for capturing and analyzing the throughput impact due to dynamic CFI across configured system bandwidths. Experimentation is carried out for comparing the downlink throughput of the system with Static and Dynamic CFI modes. A novel study has been conducted on downlink throughput for TCP and UDP traffic in different LTE bandwidths. The study shows that system performance in terms of Downlink (DL) throughput has drastically improved by using Dynamic CFI in LTE network.

Author Keywords: OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) and PHICH (Physical Hybrid-ARQ Indicator Channel)

articleTitle: Effects of robot-mediated gait training combined with virtual reality system
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: Previous robot-mediated gait training has been proven several limitations such as pointless repeated motion training, decreased presence, etc. In this research, adult stroke patients were participated in robot-mediated gait training accompanied with virtual reality program. The results indicated virtual reality system could contribute to muscle strength and balance ability.

articleTitle: Dual region based color channel registration for multiple color filtered aperture image
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: This paper presents a dual region based cross-channel registration for the dual color-filter aperture (DCA) image. Despite a DCA image contains depth information, disparity calculation between its color channels is a complex problem. The proposed registration method consists of four steps: (1) dual region division, (2) disparity map generation using Cross-Channel Normalized Gradient (CCNG), (3) disparity refinement using simple linear iterative clustering(SLIC) superpixel and (4) reconstruction aligned color channel using inpainting. Experiment result shows that the proposed method performs significant for DCA image registration and depth estimation.

articleTitle: Lifelog-based classification of mild cognitive impairment using artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: The swift diagnosis and treatment of mild cognitive impairment (MCI), as a prestage of dementia, are important to reduce the enormous costs of dementia treatment. The aim of this paper is to investigate the potential features in human behavior to facilitate the early diagnosis of MCI. In order to extract specific features from lifelogs, we collected data of activity and sleep using Fitbit's wrist band worn day and night from 12 subjects, for 12 week each. These data were analyzed using the SPSS (Statistical Package for Social Science) for verification and 12 total numbers of the significant features are extracted, further these features used for classification based on artificial neural networks (ANNs). ANNs with 8 input neurons (extracted features), 4 hidden neurons, and output neurons (diagnosis) were used to classify the patients. The results indicate that lifelog-based classifier have a good capacity (AUC=0.81 ±0.08) to discriminate MCI patients from healthy controls.

articleTitle: A PVT-compensated sinusoidal wave generator with phase modulation for multi-channel sensor applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: This paper presents a PVT-compensated sinusoidal wave generator exploiting phase modulation for multi-channel sensor applications. The sinusoidal wave is generated by a DDFS with a PVT-compensated relaxation oscillator. The sinusoidal wave generator is fabricated in 0.18 μm CMOS technology, occupying an active area of 1.099 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with a power consumption of1.55 mW.

articleTitle: Simple 3D splint reconstruction using a low cost smart phone line laser 3D scanner
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electronics, Information, and Communication (ICEIC)
abstract: This research is focused on development of the simple and cheap a 3D scanner and 3D splint reconstruction method for health service sites in remote areas. Line laser generator and smart phone camera are used to obtain the pattern of the interested patient external organs, then, the point cloud image is created using a triangulation calculation. RANSAC and Poison surface reconstruction technique are used to generate mesh object. The splint surface is generated by replacing mesh object by simple geometry shapes. Finally, the extra parts are added to the splint in order to enhance splint with extra features. The real splints are printed from the experiments on a patient in order to confirm the accomplishment of the proposed method.
